notes: BETA 2.29.98: the free Edge voice works reliably again (2.29.97 lost that fix and often fell back to the offline voice). The engineer no longer says nobody is near you in practice when a car is ahead, and fewer lines pile up when you cross the line. Correction: the 2.29.97 notes mentioned better fuel calls in timed races and 3D lap playback, but those are not in this beta. These changes passed automated tests and demo runs but were NOT tested in a real game yet, so please report what you find.
